batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c CL White b NLTC Perera

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b DW Steyn

batting.name: P Dogra
batting.dismissal: c NLTC Perera b DW Steyn

batting.name: SP Narine
batting.dismissal: c NLTC Perera b Anand Rajan

batting.name: GH Vihari
batting.dismissal: c P Dogra b Iqbal Abdulla

balls.text: it's on a length, a slower one and Pathan only swings it away, stands and delivers as they say and it's gone over long-on for a six! what a way to end the innings!
too wide outside the off but he does not let it go, has a dab at it and runs across to third-man for a single
was looking to slog it away but a slower ball that and beats the bat, hits the pads, was going down the leg side this time
fuller on the off stump and driven down to long-on for a single only
outside the off stump, very full, wants to crash it away, misses

whoa, what a catch, low down at point, that's taken Narine out of the equation, was outside the off and pitched up, he slices it to the fielder, Perera takes a good one...but wait a minute, that's a no-ball now, is it? One angle suggested it was, but the other one says it wasn't! Given out!
short of length and cuts it away to the deep third-man for a single
and now he opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single

and now Pathan replies in his own style, short of length outside the off stump and he's been thwacked over mid-wicket for a six! And then Pathan gets both his hands up in the air and applauds his own shot!
bouncer in the 19th over, fast and one that's at 147 km/hr, Pathan did well to get under that one!
short and wide and he wants to cut it away, gets it higher than farther and it's been hit in the area between the point fielder running back and the third-man and sweeper running towards the ball
and now he's hit it straight to long-on, caught! was a fuller one and slightly slower too, looks to hit it in the air but does not time it too well, straight to Perera, another one's bitten the dust

shot, shot, shot! He's been tonked over the bowler's head for a huge six, when he hit it, it looked to have have come off the edge and seemed to have gone up really high but it soon clears the fence and with much ease
short of length and angling into the batsman, was looking to pull it away, misses and there's an inevitable shout for an lbw, given not-out
slower one again and this is a lot fuller, he checks his stroke and then hits it over the extra-cover, Vihari is first befuddled by the turn on it at the boundary but recovers well to field it
and back of the hand slower one from the bowler this time, around 100 km/hr and it neither gets to the batman nor bounces, beats the edge
slower one that's pitched right up to the bat, again a slog goes to the deep mid-wicket fielder
on a length and wants to slog it but can only hit it straight to long-on for only a single
slog through the mid-wicket area for a couple of runs to bring up their 100 with three to go
very short, very wide and he cuts it straight to White at short cover, the captain misfields with the ball going through his hands
fuller on the off stump line, driven straight to long-off for a single
shorter on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single
not-out this time but the appeal was as loud as the previous one, was a wrong 'un and he was looking to defend at it, gets an inside edge on to the back pad

he's gone, lbw to a googly that he fails to read! he's had a torrid time tonight has Tendo, first against Steyn and now to Mishra, was looking to cut the ball which came in to him and his bat was as far from the ball as Kolkata is from the playoffs, misses it and given out
fast and furious and Tendo knows nothing about it! it was a bouncer and very close to the body, took his eyes off it and it hits him some place and rolls over to the leg side
short of length yet again, 141 km/hr and the batsman has to get back quickly and then defended back to the bowler
short of length outside the off stump, wanted to cut it away but misses
down the leg side and that's been flicked off his pads for a four, the line wasn't the best from the bowler
short of length and very quick, gets his bat down quite late and the inside edge runs to the leg side for a single

gone, caught, Steyn has countryman Kallis! was on his pads, was quick too and he was looking to flick it over the deep square-leg region, gets bit of an edge and goes straight to the fielder at the fence
slower one and he wants to get across to outside the off stump and flick it away but does not beat the short fine-leg fielder, only a single
shorter in length but outside the off stump, cuts it to third-man for a single
poor ball on his pads and easily glanced away to a very fine, fine-leg for a four
slower one from the back of the hands, opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single
shorter in length and tapped to the off side for a single
was walking down the track and gets hit on the pads, there's an appeal for it but the impact was outside the off stump
pushed to the leg side and not for runs again, end of another good over
wow, what turn, lot of it and at good pace, grips from the leg-stump line and almost squares him up.
fuller on the middle stump and driven down to wide long-on for a single
slows it down, shorter and he wants to cut it away, straight to the backward point fielder
on his pads, tapped away to the leg side for a single
umpire-killer, had that hit Rauf, he would have been in trouble, it was hit with some brute force and straight, Rauf ducks for cover and it seeps through to the fence
shorter outside the off stump, opens the face to steer it down to third-man
short of length outside the off stump and cuts it to the point fielder
short of length and he pulls it away to deep square-leg, Steyn comes around to his right and then misfields, they come back for the second
closer to the stumps this time, was on the off stump and defended to the off side
well played by Pathan, was a shorter one, slight width to guide it through the fine third-man region, the fielder Mishra makes a dive but is too far
short of length and he swivel-pulls it to deep square-leg for a single
fullish from Mishra and caressed down to long-on for a single
that's quite full this time and tucked away to the leg side for a single
floats it up again and spins away, pushed to the off side for a single
shorter, wider and he cuts it but the lack of pace disturbs his timing, it's in the air en route the deep cover fielder
fuller and gets his bat and pad out and defends it back
he was looking to throw the kitchen sink there, was floated up to him too, but the wrong 'un beats the stroke and the inside edge travels to fine-leg after missing the stumps
lot fuller from him and he slogs it over the in-field, the long-on runs across to his right to field it
gets his bat and pads forward and wants to defend, it a quickish googly and hits the pads

gone, lbw, was looking to sweep it away but missed! was slightly slower from the bowler, the batsman was looking to slog it away, but he's played it too quickly there and missed, the ball sneaks through and hits the front pad and the umpire this time gives him
sweeps away this time to one that's slightly closer to him, goes to fine-leg for a single
pitches it right up to the bat with bit of turn away from him who pushes it to the point area
fuller from the leggie and it's swept away square for a couple of runs
flatter one hit down to long off for a single
stops at the last moment in his action and he defends it this time
shorter in length and tapped to the long-on fielder for a single
the googly from Mishra and on the off stump, slog-driven down to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump, bit of turn away but defended to the off side
straighter one and on his pads, tapped to the leg side for a single, they want to come back for the second and apply pressure on the fielder too, but well done
and now a quicker one, straighter one, tapped back to the bowler who runs to his right and fields well
ooh, turn, slow one at that which allows Kallis to adjust his stroke but still hits his pads, excellent delivery that
fuller and tipped away to the leg side for a single
and now looks to chip it away, gets some pad again and another appeal, but this wasn't out
loud appeal for lbw, and that's given notout, was probably high, was looking to sweep that one and missed
shot, he's just come in to bat and he plays the reverse stroke, was fuller and a leggie, hits it against the turn and gets a four through point
outside edge missed, was looking to drive it straight but misses
straighter one and on the off stump, pushed to the off side, the point fielder runs in, Morgan wanted the single but is sent back, the shy at the stumps misses
on a length and tapped down to long-on for a single
not too much turn on that one, was on a length and he cuts it away and gets it through short third-man, well fielded by Vihari, who sprints after it and dives well
shorter in length and slightly spin back into the batsman, pushes it down the ground for a single

shorter in length and Gambhir has been run-out here! how often have we seen this, Gambhir has cut the ball to the point fielder and started running, Kallis did not want the run and by the time the batsman realises this, he is already half the way down the track, the throw's at the striker end and Parthiv whips 'em off
whoa, what a shot, Kallis has tried to slog sweep it away and gets only an inside edge through the keeper for a four
shorter in length and that's been misfielded by Vihari at deep square-leg, rolls over for four, Kallis was moving away and went for the pull
shorter in length and just does not come on too quickly, patted back to the bowler
fuller on the middle and driven straight down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and he looks to force it through the off side, straight to the point fielder
shorter in length and on the middle stump, 123.7 km/hr, flicked away to the leg side
shorter in length and tapped to the off side but not for runs
dropped at short cover! it was a difficult chance alright, he was looking to go over the off side and get its to White's left who jumps up high and gets one hand to it
shorter in length and outside the off stump, guides it straight to point this time
on his pads yet again and for the second time in a row that's called a wide
down the leg side that one, swinging further down for a wide
finally something off the middle of the bat for GG, he was looking to go down the track, gets it ful and smacks it over through mid-on for a couple
shorter in length but a slower one, opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
outside the off stump and drives it well but straight to the cover fielder
length ball outside off and he manages to nurdle it away to fine-leg for a single
shortish in length and at 133 km/hr, he's rooted on his crease and defends to the off side
short of length and cramping him for room , works it away to short fine-leg for a single

top-edged and caught! it was a short of length delivery alright, but slightly outside the off stump and he was looking to slog it over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and it's gone up and down for White to complete an easy catch at short cover
very loose ball, on his pads and with the fine-leg up inside the circle that's not the best delivery, he has a swing at it and gets a four over the short fine-leg fielder
short of length and flicked away to short fine-leg for a single.

ooh, both could have got out there, short of length and he was looking to pull it away, does not come off the middle and falls just short of mid-wicket who then has a shy at the non-striker's end where GG is far down the pitch, misses again
short of length and they are off for a quick, but a risky single, White fields well and has a throw at the striker's end, misses the direct hit but he was probably home anyway.
and now he goes down the track but misses, almost a yorker-length ball and fails to squeeze it through
swing away from the batsman this time, it was on a length and he was looking to play it behind point for a single, the bit of swing beat him
shorter in length, 128.9 km/hr, pushes through to the extra-cover fielder
slower one on the off stump and pats it to point for a quick single, Sammy has a shy at the stumps and he misses, which allows them to return for the second
and another one, bouncer and Bisla does not have anything to do with it, sways away again that leads to Steyn asking him to have a go at it
bouncer and a good one at that! gets the batsman to sway away from it, which was well done too!
outside edge and it rushes through to third-man for a single this time to get off the mark
only the second ball for GG and he carefully defends the length delivery to the off side
trying to cramp for room, he tucks it away to the leg side for a single
gets back his line does Steyn, and it's on a length too, pushes it to the off side
very, very poor ball from Steyn, it seemed to have got stuck in his hand, pushes it down the leg side and it goes further down for five wides
nipped back into the batsman, tapped away to the leg side and they are off for a quick single
length ball outside the off stump, 129.9 km/hr and pushed to the short cover fielder
shorter in length and opens the face of the bat to the point fielder
up and over and beats the mid-off fielder, it on a length and he carves it over mid-off for a four, his second for the night
shorter in length yet again, slightly slower, 125.3 km/hr, did not come on and he was looking to play it through the covers, just falls short of the short cover fielder
shorter in length, some pace on it too, 137 km/hr, defended off the back foot to the leg side
outside the off stump, shorter in length and lets it go through to the keeper this time
and after that bouncer comes the fuller delivery, he did not get too much on the front foot, gets bit of his bat to mid-on for a single
bouncer this time and it's rather high, he does not have too many difficulties going under that one
short of length on the off stump, again there's bit of swing away and defended off the back foot
short and wide and it's driven away through the covers for a four, was in the air for some time but is able to get it in the gap there
within the stumps and on a good length, swinging it away from Bisla and he defends it back to the off side
and again, six more to finish it off, two sixes off successive deliveries and Sammy's sealed the deal, Hyderabad is through to the playoffs!
whoa, mis-hit for a six! it was not off the middle of the bat, was tossed up outside the off stump, Sammy gave it his all and for that second it looked it could have been caught, instead...!
on a length this time he gets bit of a bat on it, hits it wide long-on for a couple of runs
and now wants to go inside out, gets only an outside edge to the short third-man fielder
shortens the length and he was looking unwind there, gets his bat down and pushes it to long-on for a single

aww, that's not the best ball there, attempts a yorker and it was swinging in too, gets some bat on it and it rushes away for a four, cannot fault the effort of the bowler there, just the execution goes a tad awry

what a ball, bowled! no-one saw that till very late, neither the bowler, nor the commentator, and I think the batsman was the only guy who knew something was amiss, looks back and sees the bails on the floor! Was a yorker length ball and it's sneaked through his defences!
what a yorker, almost unplayable, in-swiging too and right up to the block-hole, somehow he gets some bat on it to the leg side
full-toss but just not able to get it off the middle of the bat, hit it straight to long-on
fuller outside the off stump and he tries to throw his bat at it, gets some bat on it for a single at long last!
full-toss on the leg stump and flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single, Sammy wanted the second but is sent back on time
maiden from Narine at such a crucial stage, he defends it back to play out a runless over!
whoa, beaten! that was outside the off and turning back, beats the outside edge, what a delivery
and now he's defended it off the back foot yet again, off the middle of the bat this time
shorter but it's really quick and bit of turn away, defended it to the off side
and now he gets some bat on it, defends it back to the bowler, interesting
big big appeal for a caught behind, went away from the bat who was looking to defend at it, hits the thigh through to the keeper
drilled back but the bowler gets a hand to it, fielded well and that ends an excellent over from Abdulla!
and fuller again and played away to mid-wicket now, for another dot
fuller and almost yorked him, tapped down to mid-on
twist in the tale? he was looking to slog it away and this time he gets an outside edge to backward point, easily caught! why would you play this shot with the required rate under six?
fuller on the off stump but wide outside, and this time Perera wants to slog it away, gets the toe of the bat and it rolls over to long-off
whoa, wants to slog it away this time, gets an inside edge to deep square-leg for a single
fullish one on the middle, plays it right in front of his pads and taps it to long-on for a single
down the leg side, it was a quicker one from the bowler but very full down the pads and missed by the batsman
shorter in length and pushed it to deep cover for a single
shorter again and he's quickly back and defending back
spin away from the batsman, shorter and he adjusts accordingly and tapped back

fuller on the off stump and he taps it to the side, goes for a quick one, the problem is that it's only White who goes for it and Vihari's firmly plated at the non-striker's end, by the time the batsman's realised that, he's reached the point of no return, the throw comes in and the keeper whips 'em off
very full from Narine, was looking to play it off the front foot, gets a leading edge to the off side
fullish on the middle and pushed into the covers for a quick single
shorter this one but that's turned away from the batsman and tapped down to long-on for a single
sweeps it from outside the off stump and gets it to fine-leg for a single

given, lbw, that's number two, but Parthiv's showing his bat to the umpire! that was on the middle stump and probably straighter too, was looking to flick it away but misses, right in front alright but the question is whether there was an edge to it
fuller again and that's pushed down to long-off for another single, doing it easily here
round the stumps, shorter outside the off and tapped down to long-on for a single
and this is a good one, pacy delivery and Vihari was looking to crack it through the off side, gets beaten on the inside edge
gets the line back to the middle stump and that's swung back in too, tapped to mid-off
poor ball, he's getting them to swing but this is too close to the leg stump from where it swings further down the leg side, beats Bisla and that's gone for five wides
fuller on the off stump and pushed into the covers this time
and this is down the leg side and he wanted to get a bit of bat there, gets nothing on it but gets a wide for it
outside the off stump, fuller and there was a hint of swing away from the batsman, shoulders arms
fuller on the off stump and tapped down to long-off for a single
fuller outside the off stump and glides it through the backward point area for a single
sweeps it away to fine-leg to get a single to get off the mark
goes back this time and flicks it away to the leg side, wanted one but sent back
on the length and tapped to the off side

gone this time, reverse-sweep attempted and misses, given out lbw! you cannot fault Dhawan for his stroke here, he was in that kind of mood where whatever he was trying was coming off, still, he's out now and KKR have got their first
shorter in length and tapped down to long-off for a single
on the leg-stump line, spinning further down that side, could have left it alone for a wide but what he does is to almost hook it away!
length ball that's tapped down the ground for a single
walks down the crease and uses a lot of wrists to flick it away
and that's cut through the point region for a couple of runs, went through the left of the in-fielder there, could have dived?
continues his favourite length, shorter and it's outside the off, tapped down to long-on for another one
shorter in length and tapped away to the long-on ergion for a single
shorter and outside the off, cut away to point for a quick one
short and wide and cut straight to the point fielder, a better over from Narine this for the KKR
on his pads and very full, a graceful drive but straight to mid-on
looks to sweep it away but hits his pads and rolls over to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and pushed into the covers
offie from Narine and he goes down the track, does not get to the pitch of the bat and taps it down to long-off
short, wide, no turn on that, cut away to the deep cover for a single

wow, he's toying with the bowling here, was walking in his crease and looking to force the bowler to bowl to his, gets his full on his pads and that's flicked away gloriously for a four to backward square-leg
full-toss outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
shorter in length and a lot slower too, tapped down the ground for a single
on his pads again but this is a lot fuller and flicked to deep square-leg where Pathan comes over to field but by then they have come back for a second
charges down the track and pushes it down to mid-on there, wanted a single but sent back
bad ball that, short of length from the bowler but outside the leg stump and he goes for the hook, gets some glove through to fine-leg for a four
short of length and tapped away to the leg side for a single
this man is suddenly turning it on, was fuller this time, slower too, sudden change in pace but that's bothering the batsman, he goes inside out and through extra-cover for a four
and that's quite clearly the stroke of the game, he was looking to go down the track and he delivers it short, bouncer, Dhawan needs to jump up high and hit it over the covers for a six! whoa!
short of length yet again and opens the face of the bat, very late down to third-man for a single
driven down the ground for a single there to get Parthiv back on strike
up to the bat on the off stump and tapped to the off side, straight to the fielder
short of length and tapped back to the bowler, fielded well on his follow-through
well bowled that, yorker length and dug out to the leg side, he was looking to go for the single too but he's sent back by Dhawan
short of length and on his body, he has the time to pull it away to deep square-leg for a single
on his pads yet again and easily clipped off his pads to fine-leg for a single
on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side for a single
short and wide and cut hard, beats the point fielder but there is a deep fielder there and restricted to 1
and finally Dhawan gets the stroke he was looking for, gets full enough to play the slog sweep and hes deposited it over mid-wicket for a six!
slows it down and that's tapped to the off side
outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
shorter, quicker, angling in and he wants to jab it over the on-side, inside edge to the pads
no, no, no, that's not how you compensate for the line, it's sent down the leg side and it's been swept away for a four!
cut away for a four! it was one outside the off and that width along with Pathan's usual short length allows him to go hard at it
shorter one, quicker too and turning back into the left-hander and its tapped to the covers
and now slogged away to the leg side for a single this time, it was fuller and gets bit of an inside edge
on a good length and very close to the stumps, defended to the off side
shorter again and turning away from the bat, cut hard but to one of the covers fielder in the circle
pitches it right up to him this time and defended to the off side
wow, that was short but he's pulled it away over the square-leg area for a four! it stood up to be hit there...
just outside the off stump and tapped to the off side before a loud call of 'No!'
oww, almost, he was looking to go down the track and whip it across the line, gets an inside edge on to the pads, there was a huge appeal there but well-umpired under pressure
up and over, that was short, wide and he was going down the track to smack it away, easily does that and adds four more to his already burgeoning innings
short of length and angling into the batsman at 136.4 km/hr, wants to flick it away but hits the pads, rolls over for a leg-bye
goes down the track yet again and drills it through the in-field, Kallis is at mid-off and he rushes to his right, dives and stops it
short and on the off stump, pushed to the mid-off fielder
on the middle stump and flicked away to square-leg, not for runs though, another excellent over from Pathan
poor delivery down the leg side but very well kept by the keeper, dives to his right to close
very short this time and still goes down the track to push it to long-off for a single
was looking to go down but the shortness of the ball makes him tap it to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and tapped away to mid-wicket for a single
keeping it up to the bat this time, pushes it to mid-off now
fuller on his pads and driven to mid-on this time
goes down the track and mistimes it to mid-on, Pathan was on the edge of the circle and the ball bounces well in front of him at the wide mid-on region for a single
that's slightly outside the off stump and punched off the back foot to the point fielder
shorter in length outside the off stump and defended to the off side
shorter in length and tapped to wide mid-on for a single
shorter again but it's on the middle stump, this time he walks across to flick it away to fine-leg for a four, two in two, and good shots at that too
short of length and cut through the point region for a four, was a tad wide too and he went for it, was in the air but away from the fielders
shorter from the bowler and pulled away to square-leg, bit of a fumble from GG and they are through for a single
quicker from round the stumps, hits his pad at some stage and so there's an appeal but umpire gives it not-out
shorter again and tapped to the square-leg fielder this time
not up to the bat and he's tucked it away to the leg side for a single
shorter from round the stumps and opens the face of the bat to defend it to the off side
fuller and tapped to mid-on, off for a quick single
